condition_text.header: A few things to keep in mind before you chat.
condition_text.condition:
- Please don't type anything private or confidential. Your messages are saved, and the site owner can read them.
- Replies are AI-generated from the owner's real background, so they can still be wrong. Treat them as a preview, not as the owner's own words.
- It's not a technical assessment, and the answers aren't proof of skill.
- Messages are used only to run and improve this chat, and are never sold. The AI provider processes them to produce replies.
- Sent something you'd rather remove? Ask the site owner and it will be deleted.
